06270 `Athlay {ath-lah'ee}

字根已不使用, 其意為 壓縮; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Athlai 1; 1

亞勒 = "被耶和華苦待的"
1) 比拜的眾子之一, 因以斯拉的要求而被迫和其外邦妻子離婚 (#拉 10:28|)

from an unused root meaning to compress;; n pr m

AV - Athlai 1; 1

Athlai = "whom Jehovah afflicts"
1) one of the sons of Bebai and one who put away his foreign wife in
   the time of Ezra
